Telangana High Court orders continued bullet-resistant vehicle for ex-IPS officer

The Telangana High Court has ordered the continuation of a bullet-resistant vehicle for RS Praveen Kumar, a former Indian Police Service officer. The court's directive ensures the provision of this security measure remains in place. This decision addresses the security needs of the former officer.
